item.text:
Audited the Roman transliteration verse by verse and aligned it with all 63 Urdu lines, up from 40. Restored omitted lines from the Urdu, corrected mismatched wording and spellings, and preserved the source and other metadata byte for byte.

The reading `Khu` for `خو` remains uncertain and needs editorial sign-off.
